title: The Useful Client Brief
brief: Create a COMPLETE practical ebook titled The Useful Client Brief, for freelance designers. Portrait 6 by 9 inch ebook proportions, premium restrained editorial typography, cover, contents, introduction, five substantive chapters, useful examples, reusable brief worksheet and final checklist. At least 2500 words of useful original material; no filler, no about-the-design section. Use original typographic diagrams and varied page structures; do not include missing image placeholders. Ready for readable PDF export.

source.adaptation: Removed only the runtime clause "image API is unavailable so"; everything else is verbatim so the prior output stays a valid regression baseline.

mustHave: cover, contents, introduction and five substantive chapters
at least 2,500 words of original material
reusable brief worksheet and final checklist
no missing-image placeholders and no about-the-design section
notes: Prior output for regression: outputs/product-qualification/book.json and book.pdf. Closest direction: creator (audience is freelance designers).
